GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "Tschüss" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. yes
   B. bye (friendly)
   C. please
   D. good day (daytime greeting)

2. What does "die Eltern" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. family
   B. parents
   C. friend
   D. daughter

3. What does "das Fenster" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. bed
   B. window
   C. table
   D. bathroom

4. What does "der Sonntag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Saturday
   B. Sunday
   C. week
   D. Wednesday

5. What does "Welcher Tag ist heute?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. Which day is it today?
   B. Where is the school?
   C. What is the weather today?
   D. How old are you?

6. What does "Wie ist das Wetter?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. What is the weather like?
   B. Who is there?
   C. Where is the house?
   D. What time is it?

7. Which word is a temperature word? (1 mark)
   A. Regen
   B. Wolke
   C. kalt
   D. Wind

8. What does "sprechen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to play
   B. to help
   C. to eat
   D. to speak

9. Which room do you link with "Ich dusche"? (1 mark)
   A. das Wohnzimmer
   B. das Badezimmer
   C. der Garten
   D. die Küche

10. Which safety idea is right for the kitchen? (1 mark)
   A. Let children play with matches
   B. Keep hot pots and matches away from small children
   C. Leave the cooker on when you go out
   D. Block the door

11. How is the letter U named in German? (1 mark)
   A. ess
   B. yot
   C. bay
   D. oo

12. What does "Bis morgen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. yes
   B. thank you
   C. see you tomorrow
   D. good day (daytime greeting)

13. What does "Ja" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. yes
   B. please
   C. sorry, excuse me
   D. good night

14. Which little word goes with the noun "Bett"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. das
   C. die
   D. der

15. What does "Wo spielt das Kind?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. What does the child play?
   B. When does the child play?
   C. Who plays with the child?
   D. Where does the child play?

16. What does "der Samstag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Thursday
   B. weekend
   C. Saturday
   D. Tuesday

17. What does "der Dienstag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. week
   B. Tuesday
   C. Thursday
   D. Sunday

18. Which sentence has the verb in second place? (1 mark)
   A. Am Montag gehe ich zur Schule.
   B. Am Montag ich gehe zur Schule.
   C. Ich am Montag gehe zur Schule.
   D. Zur Schule am Montag ich gehe.

19. Which German word is the number 12? (1 mark)
   A. eins
   B. zwei
   C. zwölf
   D. neun

20. Which German word is the number 3? (1 mark)
   A. achtzehn
   B. zwölf
   C. drei
   D. fünf

21. What does "September" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. February
   B. August
   C. September
   D. December

22. What is the plural of "das Ohr"? (1 mark)
   A. die Ohrs
   B. die Ohre
   C. die Ohrer
   D. die Ohren

23. What does "kühl" mean? (1 mark)
   A. warm
   B. cool
   C. wet
   D. hot

24. What does "auf" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. in front of
   B. on
   C. between
   D. under

25. Which German word or phrase means "very good"? (1 mark)
   A. Bis bald
   B. Entschuldigung
   C. Sehr gut
   D. Guten Abend

26. Why is "ich" written with a small letter in the middle of a sentence? (1 mark)
   A. It is a place
   B. It is not a noun or a name
   C. It is always small
   D. It is a verb

27. Which German word or phrase means "friend"? (1 mark)
   A. die Geschwister
   B. der Freund
   C. die Schwester
   D. der Opa

28. Which German word or phrase means "sofa"? (1 mark)
   A. der Stuhl
   B. der Löffel
   C. das Sofa
   D. der Topf

29. Which German word or phrase means "house"? (1 mark)
   A. das Schlafzimmer
   B. das Haus
   C. die Toilette
   D. der Kühlschrank

30. Which little word goes with the noun "Badezimmer"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. die
   C. den
   D. das

31. Which little word goes with the noun "Samstag"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. die
   C. den
   D. der

32. Which German word or phrase means "song"? (1 mark)
   A. das Geschenk
   B. das Lied
   C. die Kerze
   D. der Kuchen

33. What does "April" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. September
   B. April
   C. July
   D. November

34. Which little word goes with the noun "Kakao"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. den
   C. das
   D. die

35. Which food group does "die Wassermelone" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. die Getränke
   B. das Fleisch
   C. das Gemüse
   D. das Obst

36. Which food group does "die Orange" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Gemüse
   B. das Obst
   C. die Getränke
   D. das Fleisch

37. What is the plural of "die Hand"? (1 mark)
   A. die Hands
   B. die Hande
   C. die Hände
   D. die Hander

38. Which plural has an umlaut? (1 mark)
   A. die Beine
   B. die Augen
   C. die Füße
   D. die Ohren

39. Which little word goes with the noun "Wolke"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. das
   C. den
   D. die

40. Which word is written with a capital letter? (1 mark)
   A. windig
   B. warm
   C. kalt
   D. Regen

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write the German names of these months: January, February, March. (3 marks)

42. Write the German words with der, die or das for: wall, tea, tooth, cocoa. (4 marks)

43. Write the German words with their articles for: fridge, cooker, plate, spoon. (4 marks)

44. Write the German words with der, die or das for: garden, room, sun, thunderstorm. (4 marks)

45. Write three sentences about your body in German. (3 marks)

46. Explain the difference between "Es regnet" and "Es ist regnerisch". (2 marks)

47. Write the German words with der, die or das for: water, rice, breakfast. (3 marks)

48. Fill the gaps: "Das Buch ist ___ dem Tisch. Die Katze ist ___ dem Stuhl." Use auf and unter. (2 marks)

49. Describe a floor plan of your dream house in German. Name at least three rooms. (3 marks)

50. Write the forms of "haben" for ich, du and er. (3 marks)

51. Write in German: "The lamp is next to the bed." (2 marks)

52. Write the German words with der, die or das for: head, eye, mouth, hand. (4 marks)

53. Write the German words with der, die or das for: finger, brothers and sisters, wind. (3 marks)

54. Write the German words with der, die or das for: foot, head. (2 marks)

55. Write the German words with der, die or das for: fork, wall. (2 marks)

56. Read: "Heute ist Samstag. Vater liest im Wohnzimmer. Mutter kocht in der Küche." Give the gist. (3 marks)

57. List three members of the wider family in German with their articles. (3 marks)

58. Write three sentences that say which item is in which room. (3 marks)

59. Write the German sound for each letter group: ei and ie. Give an example word for each. (2 marks)

60. Write the German words with der, die or das for: mouth, door. (2 marks)

61. Write two sentences about healthy food and one about unhealthy food in German. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — bye (friendly)
   Tschüss means bye (friendly).

2. B — parents
   die Eltern means parents.

3. B — window
   das Fenster means window.

4. B — Sunday
   der Sonntag means Sunday.

5. A — Which day is it today?
   Welcher Tag means which day and heute means today.

6. A — What is the weather like?
   das Wetter is the weather.

7. C — kalt
   kalt means cold.

8. D — to speak
   sprechen means to speak.

9. B — das Badezimmer
   A shower is in the bathroom.

10. B — Keep hot pots and matches away from small children
   Small children must be kept away from heat and matches.

11. D — oo
   In German the letter U is called oo.

12. C — see you tomorrow
   Bis morgen means see you tomorrow.

13. A — yes
   Ja means yes.

14. B — das
   It is das Bett, so the little word is das.

15. D — Where does the child play?
   wo means where.

16. C — Saturday
   der Samstag means Saturday.

17. B — Tuesday
   der Dienstag means Tuesday.

18. A — Am Montag gehe ich zur Schule.
   In German the verb is the second idea in a statement.

19. C — zwölf
   12 in German is zwölf.

20. C — drei
   3 in German is drei.

21. C — September
   September means September.

22. D — die Ohren
   The plural of das Ohr is die Ohren.

23. B — cool
   kühl is cool.

24. B — on
   auf means on.

25. C — Sehr gut
   very good in German is Sehr gut.

26. B — It is not a noun or a name
   Ich is only capital at the start of a sentence, unlike English I.

27. B — der Freund
   friend in German is der Freund.

28. C — das Sofa
   sofa in German is das Sofa.

29. B — das Haus
   house in German is das Haus.

30. D — das
   It is das Badezimmer, so the little word is das.

31. D — der
   It is der Samstag, so the little word is der.

32. B — das Lied
   song in German is das Lied.

33. B — April
   April means April.

34. A — der
   It is der Kakao, so the little word is der.

35. D — das Obst
   die Wassermelone belongs to das Obst.

36. B — das Obst
   die Orange belongs to das Obst.

37. C — die Hände
   The plural of die Hand is die Hände.

38. C — die Füße
   Fuß becomes Füße.

39. D — die
   It is die Wolke, so the little word is die.

40. D — Regen
   Regen is a noun. Adjectives are small.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Januar, Februar, März.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Wand, der Tee, der Zahn, der Kakao.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Kühlschrank, der Herd, der Teller, der Löffel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Garten, das Zimmer, die Sonne, das Gewitter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich habe zwei Augen. Das ist meine Nase. Mit den Ohren höre ich.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Es regnet uses a verb and means it is raining. Es ist regnerisch uses an adjective and means it is rainy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meaning.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Wasser, der Reis, das Frühstück.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: auf; unter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das ist die Küche. Das ist das Wohnzimmer. Das ist das Schlafzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each room correctly named.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: ich habe, du hast, er hat.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct form.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: Die Lampe ist neben dem Bett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the sentence pattern and 1 mark for neben dem Bett.

52. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Kopf, das Auge, der Mund, die Hand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Finger, die Geschwister, der Wind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Fuß, der Kopf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Gabel, die Wand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is Saturday. Father is reading in the living room and Mother is cooking in the kitchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the three facts.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: die Oma, der Opa, der Onkel, die Tante.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das Bett ist im Schlafzimmer. Der Tisch ist in der Küche. Das Sofa ist im Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: ei sounds like eye (nein). ie sounds like ee (Tier).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sound with an example.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Mund, die Tür.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

61. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Obst ist gesund. Wasser ist gesund. Limonade ist ungesund.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.
